title: Massive gains coming for Dogecoin in the Future But Bitcoin is The Key To Long Term Wealth
description:
Bitcoin & Dogecoin Bear Market Breakdown | 7-Year Cycle Theory, RSI, Moving Averages & Price Outlook

Welcome back to Crypto for Freedom, where we talk about gaining financial freedom through the cryptocurrency markets.

In today’s video, we break down Bitcoin and Dogecoin as Bitcoin appears to be breaking back into its bear market range. We analyze long-term market structure using parallel regression channels, descending wedge patterns, moving averages, RSI, and the Gajian Channel to determine where the market may be heading next.

Later in the video, we dive into the 7-year cycle theory and explain what it could mean for Dogecoin’s long-term accumulation phase and future outperformance versus Bitcoin — so make sure you stick around to the end.

📉 What We Cover in This Video:

Bitcoin bull market vs bear market ranges

Historical 76% Bitcoin drawdowns and diminishing losses

Descending wedges across multiple market cycles

50W, 100W, 200W, and 300W moving average behavior

RSI oversold conditions on the daily, 3-day, 5-day, and weekly charts

Weekly Gajian Channel signals and past market bottoms

Dogecoin breaking below $0.10 and entering a potential long accumulation range

Why the next 700 days could matter for Dogecoin holders

How the 7-year cycle could lead to major Dogecoin gains later this decade

💡 Key Takeaways:

This video focuses on long-term conviction, dollar-cost averaging, risk management, and staying grounded during bear markets. Big gains historically come from patience, preparation, and consistency — not hype.

⚠️ None of this is financial advice. Always do your own research.

If you found value in this breakdown, smash the like button, subscribe, and check out the links and playlists in the description below.

Stay convicted. Stay disciplined.
We’ll see you in the next video. Peace. ✌️
